verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a sandbox execution platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents only file read/write, R2 snapshots and bucket mounting for persistence, which are storage building blocks rather than retention or deletion controls. No documented deletion API, sandbox destroy, retention policy or TTL appears, and a community comment notes there is no auto-destroy after idle time, leaving cleanup to the implementer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
